description: VATES answers questions from your organization's own knowledge base. Ask in your own language and get answers grounded in your material, traceable to the exact source entry. There is no vector database and no embedding step — knowledge is stored as plain, human-readable text and interpreted at the moment you ask, so updates take effect instantly and every answer can be audited.
